notes.title: mikapyon Update!
notes.content:
mikapyon has been updated with the following changes and is now prettier than ever!

☆ Aki warps!
☆ Press Down to slide down walls faster
☆ Improved visuals for first area
☆ Pretty stickers in all levels!
☆ Completely new ending credits scene with bonus track and fanart!
☆ Ghost shroom sound effect for better jump timing
☆ Some wood blocks have pretty patterns!
☆ Sliding 180/360 loops requires less interaction
☆ Reach maximum jump height even when button released too early
☆ Sound effects when Mika is landing are not stacking anymore
☆ Dark shadow shroom sound stops at Pause screen
☆ Dark shadow shrooms are less aggressive
☆ Rotating star platforms are less slippery
☆ Improved camera track on ramps
☆ Fixed jank slide mechanic edge cases
☆ Secret jump assist mechanics
☆ More arrow guides in levels
☆ ??!?
☆ Removed sound when bonking the ceiling
☆ New level result statistics sounds
☆ Almost instant maximum run speed
☆ More air control
☆ Higher jumps, faster landing
